# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Thorne  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>; Miss Agnes Thorne

## Appearance

Miss Thorne wears attire featuring notably puffy sleeves, exceeding those worn by others in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an encouraging, innovative, and open-minded teacher who inspires strong admiration and moral ambition in her students. She introduces creative educational activities beyond traditional methods, engaging her pupils' imaginations through nature walks, recitations, physical culture, and field trips.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P15](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0015)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne served as a schoolteacher at Brierley School, introducing innovative activities such as Friday recitation sessions, field trips to study local nature, and daily physical culture exercises. She coached her students—including Nell Harcourt, Odette Pullen, Opal Pettigrew, and Flossie Tulk—to prepare them for the Entrance and Regent's examinations. Before the exams, she extracted a promise from her scholars to refrain from late-night studying so they would remain rested. During exam week, she personally escorted several of her students to the Academy in town. At the end of June, she concluded her teaching tenure at Brierley School, leaving her pupils deeply moved by her parting address.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c32 P15](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0015), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)_
